subject: ARLO SEO — Weekly Pulse — 2026-11-06
html:
Weekly Pulse — Nov 6, 2026

~18 weeks since kickoff (2026-07-04). Fresh live pull, site_id 12704162.

Leads proxy (GA4 conversions)

Pending. GA4 (G-CP22NBPLFP) is firing on the live site, but this sandbox has no outbound access to the GA4 reporting API, so conversions can't be pulled from here. A scheduled data Action (outside this sandbox) fills this number in later — until then, leading indicators below (rank, backlinks, AI visibility) are the only available signal.

All 22 tracked keywords sat at the not-ranked floor (avg position 100) every single day this period (10/30→11/6), Google USA — unchanged since tracking began 2026-08-01, now 27 straight sessions flat.

Traffic vs last week

No change. SE Ranking's domain overview still returns no ranking keywords for askarlo.app in the US index — no organic footprint to measure traffic from yet, same as every prior pulse.

Anything broken?

No. All 62 SEO Report Email runs since kickoff are green, 62/62 all-time, zero failures (confirmed directly via GitHub Actions — Thursday's 2026-11-05 schema/Offer wiring, run #62, shipped cleanly). Backlinks flat at 3 / 2 referring domains, unchanged since 2026-09-10 (13th straight week flat). Domain Trust flat at 6, unchanged since September. AI Result Tracker still has zero LLM engines configured — no AI-visibility baseline exists; this remains a human decision in SE Ranking before AI-citation movement can be tracked at all.

Reading the week

Another quiet pulse on the numbers, but Thursday's session (11-05) finally shipped the one code-actionable item that had sat as an undecided "human call" since 2026-09-14: wiring the correctly-modeled Organization/SoftwareApplication/Person/Offer schema into the homepage and all 6 persona pages, closing a dangling-@id defect and giving AI answer engines a real pricing graph to cite. That's a structural AI-citation/trust fix, not something expected to move SERP rank by itself — and rank, backlinks, and Domain Trust are all exactly as flat as last week. Both content engines (connector matrix 5/5, comparison hub 5/5, blog 10 posts) remain fully built against current keyword demand; the levers left to move these numbers — GSC sitemap submission, off-page Phase 1 link-building (still 0/6 registries), and configuring an AI Result Tracker LLM engine — stay human-gated going into Month 5.
